boards.name: 引诀点发
boards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: key-pose design board for a fixed-camera Chinese xianxia high-definition pixel game. Image 1 is the authoritative character identity and pixel treatment reference. Closely preserve the same young adult male face, black topknot and long black hair, teal blue outer robe with pale patterned hem, white front inner robe, brown belt, jade pendant, dark boots and body proportions. Redraw only poses and action props. Use crisp hand-crafted fine pixel clusters, controlled shading, readable dark contour, same detail density as the reference, no smooth 3D rendering or painterly redesign.
Composition: a clean landscape 2 by 2 board, exactly four spacious equal cells, sequence left-to-right top row then bottom row. Full bodies never cropped, same camera slightly above, three-quarter view facing screen-right, same figure height and same ground line per cell. Quiet flat warm light-grey background, tiny ground shadows only, no scenery. Caption each cell with only its number "01", "02", "03", "04" in small dark plain type at upper left. No titles or other text. Distinct poses, comfortably separated silhouettes. Each body has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs. Hands emerge from the correct sleeve, all props have physically clear attachment and count. Preserve costume details and face through all four poses.
Action S01: precise single-hand spell release. Anatomical RIGHT hand, on the screen-left near side of this three-quarter character, retains the original drawn sword throughout: one hand grips its brown hilt, blade angled down screen-left clear of legs. Anatomical LEFT hand, toward screen-right, is the empty casting hand. The sword remains one continuous rigid blade with correct grip. Exactly two hands total.
01 preparation: staggered stable feet, sword low, LEFT casting elbow bent and hand drawn beside lower chest, fingers make a restrained two-finger spell sign.
02 extension: shoulder opens, LEFT forearm thrusts toward screen-right in a clean horizontal line, two fingers target forward; small cyan spark just ahead of fingertips, no beam hiding anatomy.
03 release: left arm reaches its clear furthest point with tiny cyan projectile now detached and moving screen-right, palm empty, slight forward torso weight. Sword arm remains low and relaxed, blade away from robe.
04 recovery: LEFT elbow retracts and hand returns by ribs, shoulders settle and feet remain stable, projectile has exited. Different shoulder, elbow and weight positions across the sequence; hair and hem lag subtly after extension. No large spell circles.
